reading.title: The Club Envelope
reading.intro_zh: 这篇短文把“良心分期”搬到了校园：象棋社装着活动经费的信封不见了，钱被人匿名地、一点一点放回来，还附上越来越“诚实”的小纸条。它和课文里的村庄、屠夫、邮局完全不同，但道德主线一样：拖着不还、只还一部分、最后才问心无愧。
passage: After the school fair, the chess club could not find its envelope of club money. The club had saved it for a weekend trip, so a large sum of money had been lost. Because only its own members used the club room, the teacher was sure the envelope must have been found by a student. For two weeks, though, it was not returned. Then, one morning, part of the money appeared on the club desk. It had been wrapped up in paper and contained a short note: "I am only half a thief." A week later, more money came back with another note: "Almost honest now." In time, every coin was returned, and the last note said, "Now I have a clear conscience." But the teacher reminded the club that honest people return everything at once, not bit by bit.

questions.question: What had the chess club lost, and why did it matter?
options: A set of chess boards borrowed from the school library.
A list with the names of all the club members.
Its envelope of club money, which had been saved for a weekend trip.
A small prize the club had won at the school fair.
questions.explanation_zh: 开头说 the chess club could not find its envelope of club money，而这笔钱是 saved...for a weekend trip，所以丢的是攒着去旅行的活动经费，影响很大。

questions.question: Why was the teacher sure the envelope had been found by a student?
options: Because only the club's own members used the club room.
Because a student had already said sorry to the teacher.
Because someone had seen the envelope fall into the river.
Because the school fair was held far outside the town.
questions.explanation_zh: 短文说 Because only its own members used the club room，老师据此推断信封一定是被某个学生捡到的（must have been found by a student）。

questions.question: How did the money come back?
options: All at once, on the day after the fair.
It was mailed back inside a new envelope from a bank.
The teacher found it all under the club desk by accident.
A little at a time, over several weeks, with notes.
questions.explanation_zh: 钱不是一次还清：先是 part of the money 出现，A week later more money came back，最后 In time, every coin was returned，分几次、还带着 note，是分阶段归还。

questions.question: What did the notes show about the person who returned the money?
options: That the person blamed another student for taking it.
That the person slowly admitted being less of a thief and more honest.
That the person wanted a reward for giving it back.
That the person had never really taken the money at all.
questions.explanation_zh: 三张 note 从 "I am only half a thief" 到 "Almost honest now"，再到 "Now I have a clear conscience"，显示这个人一点点承认自己不再那么像小偷、越来越诚实。

questions.question: What did the teacher want the club to learn?
options: That winning the fair matters more than the money.
That it is fine to keep money if you feel sorry later.
That honest people return everything at once, not bit by bit.
That the club should stop keeping any money at all.
questions.explanation_zh: 结尾老师提醒大家 honest people return everything at once, not bit by bit，意思是诚实就要一次、完整地归还，而不是像分期那样一点点还。

writing.intro_zh: 今天抓五个 Lesson 45 的“匿名归还”句式：用 had been lost 写之前已经丢了，用 while taking 写丢东西时正在做的事，用 must have been found 对过去做强推测，用 had been wrapped up...and contained... 描写被送回的包裹，最后用 In time...was paid back 写一笔钱终于被一点点还清。

patterns.title: a large sum of money had been lost
patterns.source: A large sum of money had been lost.
patterns.focus_zh: had been lost 是被动 + 过去完成，强调“在那之前钱已经丢了”，重点在丢失这件事，而不是谁弄丢的。
patterns.task_zh: 仿写一句：写一笔钱、一件东西或一份文件在某件事发生时已经丢了，用 had been lost 突出丢失的结果。
patterns.sample: By the end of the trip, a large sum of money had been lost.
patterns.tip_zh: had been + 过去分词 是被动；它发生在另一个过去时间点之前，所以用 had。

patterns.title: while taking ...
patterns.source: Sam Benton had lost his wallet while taking his savings to the post office.
patterns.focus_zh: while taking... 表示“正在做某事的时候”，用来交代事情发生时的背景动作。
patterns.task_zh: 仿写一句：写某人在做某件事的过程中（while taking...）丢了、弄坏了或忘了某样东西。
patterns.sample: She lost her phone while taking the heavy box to the office.
patterns.tip_zh: while taking 后面接正在进行的背景动作，主句再写真正发生的事。

patterns.title: must have been found by ...
patterns.source: The wallet must have been found by one of the villagers.
patterns.focus_zh: must have been found 是对过去的强推测：说话人没看见，但很确定某样东西一定被某人找到了。
patterns.task_zh: 仿写一句：写你没亲眼看见、但很肯定某样东西过去一定被某个人找到或捡到了。
patterns.sample: The keys are gone from the desk, so they must have been found by someone.
patterns.tip_zh: must have been + 过去分词 = 对过去的强烈推测，比 maybe 更肯定。

patterns.title: It had been wrapped up ... and contained ...
patterns.source: It had been wrapped up in newspaper and it contained half the money.
patterns.focus_zh: 用 had been wrapped up 写它被包起来，用 contained 写里面装着什么，一起描述一件被送回来的东西。
patterns.task_zh: 仿写一句：描写一个被送回或被发现的包裹、盒子或信封——它被什么包着，里面装着什么。
patterns.sample: The parcel had been wrapped up in old paper and contained half the club money.
patterns.tip_zh: had been wrapped up 说“被包好了”，contained 说“里面有”，两个动词分工不同。

patterns.title: In time, ... was paid back
patterns.source: In time, all Sam's money was paid back in this way.
patterns.focus_zh: In time 表示“经过一段时间，终于”，was paid back 是被动，一起写出一笔钱最终被还清。
patterns.task_zh: 仿写一句：写一笔钱、一份债或一件东西经过一段时间后，终于被一点点还清或归还。
patterns.sample: In time, every coin of the club money was paid back to us.
patterns.tip_zh: In time 不是“准时”，而是“最终、过了一段时间以后”；was paid back 强调钱被还回来的结果。
